$description: Text (library wave 2, extend): the tokens of the display and lead styles, the line clamp and the expandable text. The other text roles are in components.tokens.json.

text-display-text.$description: Display: the text color (one key figure or a sign-in or welcome heading).

text-display-font-size.$description: Display: the top step of the type scale (20px today; a larger display step of the scale goes here when the scale gets one).

text-display-letter-spacing.$description: Display: tight letter spacing, as large type needs.

text-display-line-height.$description: Display: a tight line height, so a two-line statement stays one block.

text-lead-font-size.$description: Lead: one step above the body size.

text-lead-line-height.$description: Lead: a relaxed line height for an opening paragraph.

text-lines-2.$description: lines={2}: the number of lines a clamped text shows.

text-lines-3.$description: lines={3}: the number of lines a clamped text shows.

text-lines-4.$description: lines={4}: the number of lines a clamped text shows.

text-expand-gap.$description: Expandable text: the space between the text and its Show more button.
